notes: Three full storeys of windows on the main block (sills at about 5, 14.5 and 23.5 ft), floor to floor about 9.3 ft; a small basement window near the ground on the south is not a storey. South: the stretch 0.62-0.75 at storey 1 is smeared (an entry porch); the left wing 0-0.1 shows no windows; the right wing 0.73-1.0 has one small high window. East: front porch with two arched doors at 0-0.25; storey 3 is hidden behind the lower hip roof, so left out; lower right of storey 1 partly behind a bush. North: a large tree hides 0.2-0.72 at all storeys, so the openings there are not recorded (the detailer will invent them); storey 3 left of 0.72 only glimpsed. West: a balcony with railing at storey 3 in front of a wide opening (likely a door); the right end 0.86-1.0 is smeared, storey 1 partly behind a fence. The wide opening behind the west balcony is recorded as a 60 in window (a door would not place).
